objects.original: Finite-dimensional real inner-product normed E, its Borel measurable structure, actual standard Gaussian gamma_E, and real L2 equivalence classes.
objects.reconstructed: The reconstruction explicitly names the same compatible real Hilbert geometry, Gaussian probability and quotient L2 carrier.
objects.evidence: The five structure binders match the source objects; no replacement measure or unrelated feature carrier appears.

domains.original: Any natural j and ambient w; sample x ranges over E under gamma_E.
domains.reconstructed: For each j,w the coercion representative r_(j,w):E->R is compared under gamma_E.
domains.evidence: The two coercions in the Lean statement lead to the selected measurable representative, not a new pointwise definition.

quantifiers.original: For every j and w, equality holds almost everywhere in x.
quantifiers.reconstructed: The a.e. quantifier is inside j,w; no common exceptional set over all w is required.
quantifiers.evidence: This is the exact binder order j,w followed by ae equality, so the extra clarification is faithful.

assumptions.original: Common geometry/Borel conditions only; no unit direction or special representative assumption.
assumptions.reconstructed: The actual L2 class and its coercion are those already defined.
assumptions.evidence: The reconstruction retains ordinary arbitrary ambient w and introduces no extra measurability hypothesis.

conclusion.reconstructed: r_(j,w)(x)=H_j(<w,x>) for gamma_E-a.e. x, using the canonical integer-to-real evaluation.
conclusion.evidence: aeval and eval after coefficient mapping express the same literal right-hand side, as checked in the module proof.

scopes.original: Almost-everywhere equality of representatives, not pointwise equality for every x.
scopes.reconstructed: Explicitly disclaims pointwise equality and a universal exceptional set.
scopes.evidence: This preserves both quotient semantics and the precise measure/parameter scope.

constant_dependencies.original: No numerical constants; exceptional set may depend on j,w.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Same unrestricted parameter dependence of the null set.
constant_dependencies.evidence: No uniform exceptional set or quantitative estimate is asserted.

additional_theorem_credit: No new proof credit is created by this review.
